summary: MC-39 Aermotor tower in Apache County on the Navajo Indian Reservation, dated by the Register to the early 1930s; labelled on a 1955 USGS map; NHLR-registered 2002 and listed standing.

facts.design: 41-foot MC-39 Aermotor tower with 7 by 7 foot metal cab

events.note: labelled as Fluted Rock Lookout on a USGS topographic map portraying 1955 (published 1958)

evidence.supports: the lookout overlooks a region of the same name within the Navajo Reservation
evidence.quote: Fluted Rock Lookout overlooks a unique region of the same name within the Navajo Reservation

evidence.supports: located within the Navajo Indian Reservation
the Register names the Navajo Indian Reservation as administrator

sources.title: 1955 Map of Zith-Tusayan Butte 1 NW, Chinle Agency, AZ

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA listing gives 35.88611, -109.24919 and the NHLR gives 35.8865, -109.2479, roughly 120 m apart. The NHLR values are used, matching the brief.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR entry is the only source on construction; no staffing, fire or access source found. The Surgent highpoints page failed (expired certificate). The brief has no built event and I did not add one, because the sources say only early 1930s; the editor may want an approximate-date field. The Pastmaps map is dated 1955 and published 1958; the story says so.
